_description: ISCA'27 P21 round 3: m3p (M3+) + the break-even rule (pagemigration/r3.go): move / 1 KB block split / replicate / rule pre-placement, each taken when its accumulated regret reaches its one-time cost; constants from the platform (-switch-latency, link bandwidth, -pm-sw-latency-ns, -pm-shootdown-ns); no migration limit or cooldown (the accumulator restarts after each action). Accesses wait for running pre-placements (round 2 mechanics); copy-first is off (no contribution in the round 3 realistic test: GMEAN 2.025 with, 2.029 without). The hold cost waits for the measured drains of recent migrations at the home; replica creation pays the software latency and shootdown.
